sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ajay Kumar Shukla Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J. 
By means of the bail application, the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.413 of 2019 at Police Station-Chilkana, District-Saharanpur under Sections 498A, 323, 328, 504 IPC and Section 3/4 of the D.P. Act.
The applicant is in jail since 27.01.2023.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 02.02.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Ajay Kumar Shukla, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned A.G.A.-I for the State from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
(1).
The F.I.R. arises out of a matrimonial dispute.

1
(2). Aggravated and false allegations have been made at the instigation of some interested parties.
(3). The victim was at her parental house when the incident happened.
(4). The applicant was in no position to mix poisonous substance in the food consumed by the victim at her parental house.
(5). Medical evidence does not corroborate the prosecution case.
(6). There is a possibility of amicable resolution of the matrimonial dispute.
Well wishers of the family have initiated the process of reconciliation.
However, continued incarceration of the applicant in jail will lead to a further communication gap and the breach between the parties would become beyond recall.
(7). The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
(8). The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant-Samshad be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 21.2.2023 Ashish Tripathi  Samshad vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75413285/
